commentary.text: 90+3' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+1' 4 - 2 Inaki Williams showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Izeta (Ath Bilbao) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom left corner. It's 4:2.
90' 2 additional min. will be played.
89' Referee Juan Martinez points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) goes wild in celebration.
88' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) puts the ball into the back of the net, but referee Juan Martinez immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
88' 4 - 1 Goal! Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.

57' Alex Padilla blocks Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid)'s effort from the edge of the box.
56' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort well wide of the right post.
51' 3 - 1 Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
50' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
49' David Alaba (Real Madrid) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.

46' Ernesto Valverde makes a switch. Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) is coming on in place of Yeray Alvarez at the start of the second period.

45+3' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is adjudged offside.

45+1' 2 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Inaki Williams, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao), who beats Thibaut Courtois with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

41' 2 - 0 Goal! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Thiago Pitarch inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. 2:0.
39' A player from Ath Bilbao brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
35' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
34' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Real Madrid.
32' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
32' Juan Martinez blows his whistle after Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
28' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
27' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
25' It's a nice effort by Thiago Pitarch (Real Madrid) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Alex Padilla. Easy save.
21' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
20' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
20' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) commits a nasty foul by bringing down his opponent.

17' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
16' Poor challenge! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is penalised for tripping and Juan Martinez blows his whistle.

12' 1 - 0 Goal Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid)! Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) was put through by Daniel Carvajal and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the right side of the net. 1:0.
11' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
7' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
5' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
3' Juan Martinez shows a yellow card to Thiago Pitarch (Real Madrid) for his blatant foul.
3' That was close. Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
